newsitem.title: USA: Century Casinos sees Q2 loss $0.01-$0.02.
newsitem.headline: Century Casinos sees Q2 loss $0.01-$0.02.

text.p: Century Casinos Inc said Wednesday it expects to report a net loss for the second quarter of 1997 of between $0.01 and $0.02 per share.
It said the loss will be after an extraordinary after-tax charge of $0.01 per share, related to the refinancing of substantially all of the debt associated with the company's operations in Colorado.

The company said that for the second quarter, earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) and before the extraordinary charge, are expected to be $850,000 on casino revenue of $4.92 million.
A spokeswoman said the company expects to release its actual results for the second quarter ended June 30 within the next two to three weeks.
Century Casinos owns and operates the Womacks Casino in Cripple Creek, Colo. and operates a small casino on a cruise ship.
